engine: AIR /investment MODEL mechanic (contract D_AIR_invest_1to1 B3 + choreography 3.3): a white CASE card on the light panel - tab cells (label 11px CAPS top-left; the ACTIVE tab carries a full-cell BLACK border-bottom 2px, inactive a gray hairline), a body with a big head (1.9vw) on the left and a 5-row table on the right (gray 10px labels left / black 12px right-aligned values, hairline dividers, ~5.6vh row rhythm), and a result row of label->value pairs at 1.9vw. Clicking a tab swaps the ENTIRE dataset with a 0.3s crossfade: a ghost clone of the old value overlays the incoming one (both visibly superposed mid-flight, exactly as frame-measured on AIR), zero layout shift. T-M19 mobile: sliders do not exist - tabs tap-swap a fixed read-only dataset, the table goes full-width with right-aligned figures; the sticky bottom model pair (scroll-spy) belongs to the COMBO, not this atom. HONESTY (F1/F7): the atom computes nothing - it renders the data it is given; the lab feeds it ONLY canon numbers (22 800, 24/27 m2, 2027), zero rental rates or payback promises.

measured_teardown.move: config-driven build (the dataset swap IS the technique, so cases come as config, not markup): tabs row (role=tablist, aria-selected), body grid head+table, result pairs. Every swappable slot is a .ctt-swap wrapper holding .ctt-cur (live text) so the ghost is a SIBLING absolute overlay (right-aligned for figures, left for the head) - the fade of the live text never touches the ghost and nothing reflows. swapText writes textContent only on change (D6) and runs two opacity tweens (D4) on the inlined out-quad ease (contract: ease-out, 0.25-0.35s).
measured_teardown.cited: AIR v4 recording t2.6-9.6: CASE 1 | CASE 2 cells ~30vw with the black 2px underline jumping cells; OFFICE 110.6 M2 <-> 84.7 M2 with UNIT PRICE 60 241 520 <-> 46 577 900 crossfading superposed; result pair ~8.2 YEARS / ~553 000 at 24px. Mobile teardown f181-207: tab presets replace the desktop range calculator (T-416 -> T-M19), read-only.

cases.what: array of {tab, head, rows:[{label,value}], result:[{label,value}]}. Row labels MUST match across cases (the swap changes VALUES, not structure) - mismatch logs an honest console.error.

ease.what: 'out-quad' (contract: even ease-out, no overshoot) or 'air'; inlined bezier solver (D13).

css_surface.--ctt-table-w: table column share of the body grid (default 46%)

entry: CaseTabsTable.create(target, opts) -> { root, index, cases, els, setCase(i), destroy, ready }. target = an empty [data-ctt] container; the engine builds tabs/body/result from opts.cases. els exposes tabs and swap wrappers for machine probes; live text always sits in .ctt-cur.
law: motion = opacity ONLY (two tweens per slot: incoming 0->1, ghost 1->0; D4); zero CSS transition on GSAP-driven props - the active-tab border is a CSS state, not a tween; textContent written only on change (D6); zero layout shift on swap (ghosts are absolute siblings, row heights fixed); reduced-motion / no-GSAP = instant swap, no ghosts; the atom NEVER computes yields (F1/F7) and NEVER touches __LAB_OK__ (B15).
gate_mode: PROBE_MODE only (navigator.webdriver || ?probe - the live view gets zero auto-scrolls, per the 2026-07-05 circle law). Lab: loadStability first (CLS < 0.1 buffered from the head-inline observer + anchor drift <= 4px over 1s, D14 head script pinned the first frame); geometry pack (equal tab cells, active border 2px dark vs 1px hairline, head ~1.9vw, 5 rows at ~5.6vh rhythm, right edges of values aligned +-2px, result ~1.9vw); WCAG contrast of labels AND values vs the card >= 4.5:1; DRIVEN swap - click tab 2, at 120ms EXACTLY 2 ghosts exist (only the changed slots: head + area - the D6 discipline probe) with live opacity < 0.95, at 450ms the dataset landed (head/area texts), zero ghosts, row tops shifted <= 1px, aria-selected moved; swap back restores case 1. Mobile pack (<=768): zero input[type=range] (T-M19), tabs span the card, tap targets >= 44px, page free of x-overflow, text rects >= 16px.
proven: lab.html v1: the smart canon dataset (ET-06 24/27 metres, ET-09 entry 22 800, ET-03 keys 2027, ET-25 instalment register) on the #ececea panel between an intro band and a render neighbour.
